images.filename: Keelung Panorama From Shih Ciou Ling Fort.png
images.caption: A panoramic view of Keelung from Shiqiuling Fort looking towards Keelung Islet in 2012. In the far right, Zhongshan District is visible, marked visibly by the Hsieh-ho Power Plant and its distinctive three stacks. In the middle, Ren-Ai District is visible with Provincial Highway 2 leading towards the harbor. On the left side over the surrounding hills, Zhongzheng District is visible on the left side of the harbor.
images.alt: A panoramic view of Keelung from Shiqiuling Fort looking towards Keelung Islet in 2012. In the far right, Zhongshan District is visible, marked visibly by the Hsieh-ho Power Plant and its distinctive three stacks. In the middle, Ren-Ai District is visible with Provincial Highway 2 leading towards the harbor. On the left side over the surrounding hills, Zhongzheng District is visible on the left side of the harbor.
